messages:
Alex K: Escalating NimbleAI onboarding to CS as P1. Renewal in ~28d; customer blocked from going live. Sharing context below.

Devon L: Short summary: embedding model change caused ~12% backfill failures, intermittent SSO 403s, and tokenization mismatches. eu-west-2 ingestion latency spiked from ~600ms to ~2s during backfills.

Maria S: Im taking technical CS lead. Need a compact handoff checklist + owner list so AE/AM can message the customer. Who handles exec comms?

Alex K: Raj will handle exec comms; Maria will be CS technical lead. AE is Kyle (copied).

Raj P: Can we publish a 48hr remediation comms plan + 7-day follow-up recommendation? I want a clear cadence to send to the customer.

Maria S: Draft comms plan: 
- Ack email within 30m with single POC (Maria).
- 0-48h: daily 30-min sync until ingestion backfill progress is steady.
- 48h-7d: daily async updates; 2x weekly 30-min checkins as needed.
- >7d: 1-week postmortem with quantified impact before renewal.

Devon L: Technical notes for handoff (logs/snips):
```
INGEST_ERROR: backfill failed batch=bf-2026-03-20-12 count=124
error: "embedding mismatch: checksum != expected"
node eu-west-2/gpu-1 latency_ms=2012
SSO: token exchange 403 at auth-proxy-03
```
Config snapshot: model=open-embed-v2, quant=q4_0, batch_size=64, prefix_cache=true. Suspect vector drift after finetune.

Maria S: Customer-facing ops bullets to paste: 
- Who: Maria S (CS lead), Devon L (Support Eng), Raj P (AM), Kyle (AE)
- What: triage embedding drift, complete backfills, validate SSO, mitigate latency spikes
- When: ack now, daily sync for first 48h, EOD status updates
- How we measure: backfill success %, avg ingest latency, SSO error rate
- Temporary mitigations: rollback to open-embed-v1, reduce batch_size to 16 for backfills, route to eu-central-1 if eu-west-2 latency persists

Alex K: Customer email draft: "Hi team  weve prioritized your onboarding as P1. Maria is your CS lead and will coordinate daily updates. Immediate next step: 30-min triage call within 60 minutes; well share a remediation plan and ETA for backfill completion within 24h."

Raj P: Ill send the exec note after Maria confirms call time. Looping legal if we do a model rollback for data handling sign-off.

Maria S: Triage call set for 11:15 UTC (I will lead). Agenda: symptoms, mitigation plan, owners, SLAs.

Kyle (AE): Customer confirmed 11:15 UTC. Ive told them well own ops until unblocked.

cs-bot: Reminder: triage call at 11:15 UTC (invite sent).

Maria S: Post-call Ill upload a short runbook (rollback steps, commands, dashboard link) and update this thread within 2h.

Devon L: Rollback test command to measure embedding diff: `python tools/embed_diff.py --old open-embed-v1 --new open-embed-v2 --sample 10000` and capture recall delta.

Action items (owners):
- Devon: collect failing doc IDs, open infra ticket if backfill cluster hits OOM (ACTION).
- Devon: paste rollback playbook steps in thread (ACTION).
- Alex: send customer ack after call slot confirmed (ACTION).
- Raj: coordinate legal & AM for exec comms (ACTION).
- Maria: lead triage and daily syncs until resolved (ACTION).

Raj P: Thanks team  keep updates concise here and escalate if anything critical changes.

Alex K: Marking renewal watch and priority P1.
